Title: Generally Available: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.3 now supported on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9.3 provides access to more features and capabilities to help customers customize their operating environment while maintaining the consistency needed for more efficient management and deployment across varied infrastructures.

Key features offered:

  • New options in RHEL streamline tasks of deployment and migration via the included image builder service and the compatibility with Convert2RHEL tool
  • RHEL 9.3 also fully supports Stratis, a local storage management system for Linux that pools physical storage devices and helps to set up and oversee more complex storage configurations
  • The latest version of performance Copilot included with RHEL, adds new metrics to help you monitor the performance of—and quickly detect potential issues with—more aspects of your hardware, including interrupts, non-volatile storage and external memory
  • RHEL 9.3 includes new Application Streams for Node.js 20, Java-21, Redis 7 and compiler toolkits, so developers can take advantage of the latest technology features

Visit RHEL 9.3 Release Notes and RHEL 9.3 Release Blog from Red Hat for more information. Visit pricing page for latest RHEL pricing information.
